Optimized `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py` for large tenants. The report previously ran one invoice query per currency; it now filters using the existing `ReportContext` fields once, aggregates with `Sum("amount")`, and performs one aggregate query per account. Currency conversion was also batched through `convert_minor_units_batch`, avoiding repeated exchange-rate lookups.

For tenant 73, the report still produces 14,802 aggregates, but SQL statements dropped from 2,417 to 37 and runtime from 38.6 seconds to roughly 4.27–4.46 seconds. Profiling showed `build_summary` cumulative time falling from 39.1 seconds to 4.46 seconds. A regression test now asserts the stable 37-query count.
